items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: Never seen him in my life. Well, he died up there. We played for him.

ctx.x: I did. I played in a funeral. I didn't have them on, but seven or eight pieces. Just scrap up or anything, just to make a noise behind them. I don't know if I was a person who died. What are the words threaten like? You know old Buddy Bowler?
